rationale: param_manager.add_device_params hides and silences the slots after a device's own params from oob_accumulator on. That starts at 40 and only moves when the device has params, so a device with none (an n.b. player such as Jf Kit) left slots 16-39 as the previous device had configured them: still listed in the channel's norns params group and still sending MIDI from their actions. When the device has no params the hide loop now starts at the first slot after the stock params.
oracle: README 546: device parameters in the norns params menu send MIDI to the channel's MIDI device; README 542: n.b. devices are picked from the device picker. User decision 2026-09-11 on S4: switching to an n.b. device without params should clear the slots.
